originality.rationale: An unrestricted exact three-parameter endpoint-norm and saturation-phase classification was checked against the 2023 primary projection paper, directly relevant 2019 electrical-network full text, relevant 2021 and 2022 resistance-paper abstracts, mathematical-index searches, and recoverable earlier single-edge claims. The stronger claim that all additional disjoint edges are norm-invisible until full saturation is not supplied by a one-edge formula. No exact endpoint norm result or matching-saturation theorem was located. Two overlapping resistance articles could encode the endpoint quantities implicitly, and their full text was unavailable, so independent originality confirmation is still needed.
residual_risks: The full 2021 Ge paper treats nearly the same graph object, and its exact resistance data could encode a less explicit equivalent projection calculation; full text was not available.
The 2022 generalized mesh-star paper treats a still broader graph class at the resistance level, with unavailable full text; mathematical implication of its detailed formulas remains unverified.
Research-index absence cannot establish uniqueness, and unindexed literature may state related phase transitions.
